evidence_coverage.note: All 8 log lines reviewed. The bundle records success_criteria as unknown because wrap-text cannot carry them; the user separately stated the criterion 'https://staging.example/docs serves the new build'. That criterion is applied in this analysis but is not part of the snapshot. No mechanical signals fired because all events are unstructured log_line events; the no_tool_calls signal is an artifact of the text format, since log lines L3, L5 and L8 record tool calls.

outcome.statement: The log ends at line 8 with a second rsync call and no result for it, no further agent message, and no check of https://staging.example/docs. Nothing in the trace shows whether the new build was uploaded or served. The first upload attempt failed, but a failed attempt followed by a retry of unknown result does not establish failure of the run.

key_events.summary: User asks to deploy the docs site to staging.

references.excerpt: [user] Deploy the docs site to staging.

key_events.summary: mkdocs build reports success, so a new build existed locally.

references.excerpt: ok: INFO - Documentation built in 37.9 seconds

key_events.summary: First upload attempt via rsync over ssh to host 'staging'.
Upload fails: ssh connection to staging port 22 reset by peer. Not listed as a finding because whether it affected the outcome is unknown (retry result absent).

references.excerpt: error: ssh: connect to host staging port 22: Connection reset by peer

key_events.summary: Agent accurately reports the failure and says it will retry.

references.excerpt: The upload failed with a connection reset. Retrying.

key_events.summary: Identical rsync retried one second later; the log ends with no result.

earliest_divergence.statement: The first upload attempt returned an ssh connection error; this is the earliest observed departure from expected progress. Whether the run later recovered is unknown.

hypotheses.statement: The retry succeeded and staging serves the new build; the connection reset was transient.
hypotheses.would_confirm: An ok result for the L8 rsync plus an HTTP fetch of https://staging.example/docs showing a build marker matching the L4 build.
hypotheses.would_refute: An error result for L8, or staging serving an older build.

hypotheses.statement: The ssh failure is persistent (host down, firewall or rate limiting, wrong host alias) and the retry also failed.
hypotheses.would_confirm: An error result for L8 with the same or similar ssh error; server or firewall logs showing rejected connections.
hypotheses.would_refute: An ok result for L8, or successful ssh to 'staging' at that time.

references.excerpt: ssh: connect to host staging port 22

hypotheses.statement: Even if rsync succeeded, uploading to /var/www/docs/ may not make https://staging.example/docs serve the new build (different docroot, cache or CDN, missing reload, or 'staging' alias pointing elsewhere). The trace shows no verification of the URL.
hypotheses.would_confirm: rsync ok but the URL still serves old content; config showing a different docroot or a cache in front.
hypotheses.would_refute: The URL serves the new build after rsync, or deploy config confirming /var/www/docs is the served root with no cache.

hypotheses.statement: The log is truncated (run killed, timed out, or logging cut off) rather than the run having ended at line 8.
hypotheses.would_confirm: Harness logs showing a timeout or kill, or a longer original log.
hypotheses.would_refute: Evidence that the complete log ends at line 8 with the process exiting normally.

missing_information.item: The tool result of the L8 rsync retry and any later log lines.
An HTTP check of https://staging.example/docs after the run, with a build identifier (commit hash or build timestamp) to compare against the L4 build.
missing_information.discriminates: Decides the outcome directly against the stated criterion; H1 vs H3.

missing_information.item: Server-side evidence: sshd or firewall logs on staging around 2026-09-21T09:00:44Z, and file mtimes in /var/www/docs.
missing_information.discriminates: H2 (persistent vs transient) and whether any upload landed.

missing_information.item: Deployment configuration: what 'staging' resolves to, the served docroot, and any cache or CDN in front of staging.example.
Final agent output and harness exit status.
missing_information.discriminates: H4, and whether the agent claimed success without verification.

remediation.statement: Not tied to an established finding. If H2 is confirmed: bounded retries with backoff plus a diagnostic (ssh -v, host resolution) before giving up, and an explicit failure report. In any case the deploy procedure should end with an HTTP check of https://staging.example/docs against a build identifier before claiming success. These are specifications, not verified fixes.
